clock_domains.name: dfi_clk
clock_domains.description: DFI clock from the memory-controller side; command/write/read channels and CSR domain. 1:2 ratio to the memory clock.

clock_domains.name: clk_dqs_rd
clock_domains.description: Read-capture strobe domain (DQS from the DRAM, delayed 90 deg by the AFE DLL). Only the read-capture FIFO write side lives here.

signals.name: dfi_address
signals.meaning: DFI command/address slots from the memory controller (LPDDR4-style 7-bit CA).

signals.name: dfi_wrdata
signals.meaning: Write data from the MC, wrdata_en-qualified per the tphy_wrlat contract.

signals.name: dfi_rddata
signals.meaning: Read data back to the MC, qualified by dfi_rddata_valid per the trddata_en contract.

signals.name: dfi_rddata_valid
signals.meaning: Qualifies dfi_rddata toward the memory controller.

signals.name: dq_rddata
signals.meaning: Captured DQ byte lane in the DQS read domain; crosses to dfi_clk through the read-capture FIFO.

signals.name: dll_pi_code
signals.meaning: AFE DLL/PI phase code for write-leveling / read-gate placement. Change only between bursts.

signals.name: vref_dq_code
signals.meaning: Vref(DQ) trim DAC code from Vref training.

signals.name: zq_code
signals.meaning: Driver impedance code from the ZQ calibration FSM. Applied only while the bus is idle.

signals.name: dfi_init_complete
signals.meaning: PHY init/training done, reported to the memory controller (DFI contract).

signals.name: rstn_por
signals.meaning: Chip POR, async assert; release synchronized per domain.

cdc_points.notes: This IS the read-capture FIFO in the digital diagram - absorbs round-trip flight-time variation between DQS and dfi_clk.

reset_sequence.action: POR asserts asynchronously; all enables cleared
POR release synchronized into each domain (2ff per domain)

power_sequence.wait_for: 50 us settle (no lock status pin in v1 - add one if the AFE provides it)
